sections.text: Reset PRS electronics.
Continued POOH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 453 m surface Avg. Tripping speed 600 m/hr.
Changed handling equipment
L/d pup joint. Inspected cutters, and taper mill. L/d cutter assy.
Cleaned and cleared drill floor. Static losses 0,5 m3/hr over 10 min.
P/u and m/u the 13 3/8" EZSV plug BHA. Installed springs on centralizer.
Installed PS-21 slips
RIH w/ EZSV plug BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 0 m to 30 m. Hung up on restriction at 30m. Re-attempted to run past restriction, same hud.

Pulled BHA to surface and inspected tool. Found cement in holes for springs on centralizer, which possibly interrupted spring movement. B/o and l/d EZSV RT, p/u backup, found cement on backup RT. Cleaned off cement. M/u BHA.
RIH slowly w/ EZSV plug BHA from surface to 42 m. Passed restriction at 30m.
Installed PS-21 slips.
RIH w/ EZSV plug BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 42 m to 285 m. Restricted running speed 2 min/std. Observed hydraulic leak on IRN.
Repaired hydraulic leak IRN.
Continued RIH w/ EZSV plug from 285m to 695m
Washed setting area from 695m to 685m w/ 800 l/min 6 bar
Set EZSV at 690m bottom plug. Sheared at 27t and tagged w/ 5t. Released stinger with 22 turns
Removed ps21 slips and installed master bushing
R/b stand, p/u and m/u 3m pup and cement stand for space out
Stang back into EZSV and m/u cement hose
Verified line up and performed integrity test to 100 bar between fosvs on cement assy
Attempted to pressure test below EZSV to 20 bar, meanwhile monitored trip tank, observed 500 l/min losses. Failed test

Closed UPR and lined up to monitor annulus through choke. Pressured up annulus through kill line to 35 bar whilst monitoring below EZSV with 5 bar at the cement unit through cement assy. Observed no pressure build up on the drill pipe side. Confirmed hydraulic isolation of annulus cement plug
Pumped 10m3 wash pill at 2500 l/min 19 bar
Balanced cement plug m 690 m mixed and pumped 7,8 m3 of 1,95 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with 7,2 m3 of drill water. TOC 590 m.
Broke off cement hose and 3m pup w/ cement assy, l/d same
POOH with 5,5in DP from 687m to 500m w/ 2 min/stand. Flowback observed from 566m to 500m. M/u TDS and monitored pressure 1 bar on standpipe gauge
Installed sponge ball in saver sub and m/u TDS. Circulated 2x bu at 3500 l/min 31 bar
POOH from 500m to 405m
P/u swaco washing tool from HTS with FOSV, m/u to string and stand of drill pipe from derrick
Washed BOP, 3 passes, 1600 l/min 14 bar 20 RPM 1-4knm
Functioned BOP
Washed BOP, 3 passes, 1600 l/min 14 bar 20 RPM 1-4knm
R/b stand of 5,5in DP in derrick and l/d swaco wash tool and FOSV, drop 3in drift in string
Removed master bushing and installed ps21 slips
POOH from 405m to 16m
Removed ps21 slips and installed master bushing
POOH from 16m to surface, removed spring centralizers, l/d EZSV running tool
Cleaned and cleared rig floor
R/u diverter chains and bridle
Performed pre-job meeting to n/d diverter and BOP
